verdict.rationale: Open-source designs exist for processors (e.g. open RISC-V cores), so asking whether a chip's source is available under an open license is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no open-licensed source, RTL or firmware for the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme itself. The only open-source mention is the GenieX AI toolkit, which is ecosystem software rather than the product's own source, so it does not count here.
